piezas.titulo: Reading comprehension: Health, evidence and decisions
texto: Contextual reading of a popular science article on nutrition, preventive habits and clinical evidence: read the text examining studies on reducing cardiovascular risk. Notice how the science writer contrasts encouraging data with the caution required by sample size and possible side effects.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «ข้อจำกัดของกลุ่มตัวอย่างในงานวิจัยอาจส่งผลต่อการนำผลการศึกษาไปประยุกต์ใช้ทั่วไป» express?

opciones.texto: The sample size of a study may condition how widely its findings can be extrapolated.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «ข้อจำกัดของกลุ่มตัวอย่างในงานวิจัยอาจส่งผลต่อการนำผลการศึกษาไปประยุกต์ใช้ทั่วไป» from the text.

opciones.texto: Communicating risk information in plain language empowers citizens to look after their own health.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Long-term follow-up of treatment helps refine clinical protocols.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.

frase.texto: ก่อนตัดสินใจ ควรพิจารณาประโยชน์และผลข้างเคียง

opciones.texto: Before deciding, it is advisable to weigh the benefits and the side effects.
opciones.explicacion: The translation matches the Thai sentence.

opciones.texto: The data indicate that prevention can reduce the risk.
opciones.explicacion: This is another sentence on the same topic.

opciones.texto: Specialists warn that the evidence still has limitations.
opciones.explicacion: This sentence expresses a different idea on the same topic.

pregunta.texto: Complete the Thai sentence that expresses «Before deciding, it is advisable to weigh the benefits and the side effects.».
